summary.en: A routine afternoon at the library turns into the hunt for a corpse after an attendant turns up missing. When Conan and the Detective Boys try to solve the mystery by staying after-hours, they find themselves trapped, in the dark, and not alone. Will they catch the killer before he catches them? Drug Smuggling/Dealing Location: Beika Library Suspect: Shuji Tsugawa Tsugawa hid narcotics in the mysterious books without spines, afterwards he took the drugs and sold them a little at a time. Location: Beika Library Victim: Ayumi Yoshida Attack Types: Strangulation Culprit: Shuji Tsugawa Ayumi was to be strangled by Tsugawa while fixing her shoes. Luckily, Conan turned to call her forcing Tsugawa to hide.
summary.zhHans: 服部平次登场并与柯南展开推理较量，案件同时完成两位高中生侦探关系的建立。
